title: Annual Report 2026
text:
Letter from the Managing Director
FY26 marked another year of meaningful progress for Trent, 
driven by a portfolio anchored in customer relevance, strong 
value propositions, and long-term engagement. Our core 
fashion brands - Westside and Zudio - continued to deliver 
strong, complementary growth across segments. We are also 
encouraged by the early momentum with Burnt Toast, our 
new lifestyle brand proposition that appeals to trend-forward 
and Gen-Z consumers.
Our food and grocery business, Star continues to evolve in a 
significant way, building on the Trent playbook. The year saw 
substantial interventions with respect to the operating model 
with a refreshed emphasis on in-store customer experience. 
We remain encouraged by the traction that our own brand 
propositions are witnessing across micro markets. Own 
brands now contribute to 73% of Star’s revenues and remain 
the core differentiating proposition of the brand.  
We continue to pursue a disciplined expansion program that 
is aimed at growing share of presence in existing micro 
markets as well as establishing reach to numerous new cities 
and towns across India. This growth has been supported by a 
more robust operating backbone, enabling quicker 
turnarounds, faster refresh cycles, and improved execution  
at scale.
Alongside footprint expansion, we maintained a strong focus 
on financial discipline - optimising store-level margins and 
leveraging digital platforms to strengthen our omni-channel 
connect. Our teams remain central to execution in a relatively 
challenging macroeconomic context, driving productivity 
improvements across multiple areas and reinforcing a culture  
of pursuing excellence.
Technology and digital initiatives remained key enablers for 
Trent during the year. We continued to strengthen our digital 
ecosystem by investing in the adoption of artificial intelligence 
(AI), data analytics, and automation to enhance product 
design, merchandise planning, improve supply chain 
efficiency, and elevate in-store and omni-channel customer 
experiences. AI-led use cases are increasingly supporting 
demand forecasting, inventory optimisation, and delivery of a 
more customer-relevant engagement across channels. 
Dear Shareholders,
As we look ahead, we do so with confidence and an 
unwavering commitment to serve our customers better every 
day. To our colleagues, partners, and shareholders - thank  
you for your trust and support. We remain energised by the 
opportunity ahead and are determined to build a future-ready 
Trent that creates enduring value.
P. VENKATESALU
Managing Director
